description: This Java source file defines an Android Fragment named LogFragment, which contains a custom view for displaying logs, called LogView. It manages the layout and view setup for a log display area within an Android application.

classes.name: LogFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that displays logs within a ScrollView using a custom LogView component.

methods.name: inflateViews
methods.description: Sets up the ScrollView and LogView, configuring layout parameters, appearance, and padding, then returns the ScrollView containing LogView.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Called to create the view hierarchy; it inflates layout, adds a TextWatcher to auto-scroll on new log data, and returns the root view.

methods.name: getLogView
methods.description: Returns the LogView instance used within the fragment.
